transactioncolumncustomfield.description: Ticked by the trader when this line sells only part of a physical bundle. Holds the WHOLE source bundle out of availability until the warehouse completes the split, because the true remainder is unknown until the bundle is opened.
transactioncolumncustomfield.help: Tick this when the customer is taking part of a bundle rather than the whole thing. Enter the board feet to pick in Split BF to Pick. The entire bundle is held until the warehouse records the actual quantities.
transactioncolumncustomfield.label: Split Bundle
